musica.prompt: Calm, curious and cozy instrumental for a premium smart-home lifestyle commercial on a rainy Florida afternoon: soft acoustic guitar, light felt piano and gentle pizzicato, around 95 BPM, a light sense of mystery at the start, soft and hushed in the middle, turning warm and reassuring at the end, clean mix, no vocals, gentle fading ending.

escenas.prompt: Heavy afternoon rain over the front of the house and the palm trees.
Rain splashing on the pool and the screen cage.
The woman watches the rain from the living room, seen from behind.
The thermostat ring glow shifts slowly.
The dehumidifier starts running, its light turns on.

Static camera, same living room on a dark rainy afternoon. The woman on the sofa, seen from behind, slowly turns a page of her book; the tan pit bull resting his head on the sofa arm blinks calmly and wags the tip of his tail. Heavy rain keeps falling outside the sliding glass doors, raindrops running down the glass. Small, gentle movements only. Nothing else changes: same furniture, same lights, same dog bed by the front door. No one else appears.
Rain keeps falling over the house.
